text:
Maya: Heads-up 7 we need a hero visual for the benchmark page + a short animated gif for socials. Aim: show latency vs $/1k across Hosted/Dedicated/Private, then a tiny p95 callout.

Jae: I can make the gif if someone gives me a compact dataset. Raw numbers or normalized?

Priya: End-to-end econ pls (infra + egress). Keep columns: model,mode,median_ms,p95_ms,usd_per_1k. Small footnote for assumptions.

Owen: Dropping a quick CSV -> use it as baseline, tweak visuals for clarity. These are rounded sims from last run.

Owen: ```
model,mode,median_ms,p95_ms,usd_per_1k
rtx-v2-hosted,hosted,28,160,0.22
rtx-v2-dedicated,dedicated,20,110,0.16
rtx-v2-private,private,30,175,0.13
llamax-hosted,hosted,48,300,0.11
llamax-dedicated,dedicated,42,260,0.09
llamax-private,private,50,320,0.06
```

Lucas: Nice. My two visual ideas: (1) radial sparkline grid with mode color band; (2) split hero: left scatter (median vs $) + right vertical stack showing p95 bars. Prefer (2) for hero, gif can animate p95 bars growing.

Priya: I like (2). Keep the hero copy short: "Real unit economics. Predictable performance." Add microcopy: "Median shown; p95 in callout. Assumes 1k prompts at 1k tokens total."

Maya: Also include a tiny explainer card (below the hero) 7 3 bullets: What we measured, key takeaways, next steps (try API / request Dedicated quote).

Jae: Colors? We should use product palette teal for Hosted, indigo for Dedicated, charcoal for Private. GIF needs high contrast on mobile.

Lucas: Ill assemble static hero in Figma with export presets: PNG@2x, GIF@720p, and an SVG for blog. Will add alt text options.

Priya: For messaging variants: developer tone + enterprise tone. Dev: "Ship fast, predictable costs." Enterprise: "SLA-grade latency with cost governance." Keep CTAs aligned to utm tags.

Owen: Tracking plan: utm_source=benchmark, utm_medium=organic_social, utm_campaign=bench_wave1, utm_content=dev|enterprise. Also attach data layer event `bench_asset_click`.

Maya: Timelines: Draft hero + CSV to Lucas by 2pm PT, GIF draft by Jae at 4:30pm PT, copy variants by Priya at 3pm PT. Can we hit that?

Jae: Yep for gif draft 4:30. Will need the final CSV before animating states.

Lucas: 2pm works. Will include two layout options and a compact CSS spec for engineering.

Priya: Copy note: include an inline token-econ example in footer: "At $0.16 /1k tokens, 10k queries of 1k tokens = $1.6k." Keep it tiny.

Maya: Good. Also ask design to export a static fallback hero for email (600x300).

Owen: Once assets are live, Ill create two nurture buckets in Growth: bench_dev and bench_enterprise and wire up the toggle on the signup form.

Lucas: One more design ask: annotate the p95 bars with short tooltip text: "Why tail matters" link to appendix.

Priya: For webinar promo, reuse gif + a 15s cut that focuses on "predictability" line. Script draft: "See how performance and price line up. Join our launch webinar."

Maya: Great. If we stick to the plan we can push the page + promo tomorrow. Ping me if any blocker. :rocket:

Jae: Uploading initial GIF frames to #design-drafts in ~2h.

Lucas: Uploading Figma file + PNGs by 2:10pm PT.

Owen: I'll draft the analytics spec and post in #growth after the assets are uploaded.

Priya: Copy uploaded 7 two variants in drive: /marketing/bench-copy/hero_dev.md and hero_enterprise.md.

Maya: Thank you team. Small follow-up: add a short alt copy for accessibility and an exact calculation breakdown in the appendix slide.

Lucas: Will do alt text and appendix table.

Maya: :thumbsup:
